title: Parts import updates an inactive part in place and keeps it inactive
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · a spreadsheet program · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part, Sell Price $20.00, set inactive. [CSV-1] = a parts import file with one row for [Part-A] whose Sell Price is 25.00.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL IMPINACT PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IMPINACT-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IMPINACT-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL IMPINACT PART).
  3. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  4. Go to Settings → Data Import → Inventory and download the import template. Fill one row for [Part-A] with its Part Number, Description, Category, Cost 10.00, Sell Price 25.00 and the same bin and quantity; save it as a CSV file. [CSV-1] = that file.
  5. Check the setup worked: [Part-A] is on the Inactive tab with Sell Price $20.00; [CSV-1] has exactly one data row.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings → Data Import → Inventory, upload [CSV-1] and run the import.
  2. Go to Parts → Inventory, Active tab, search [Part-A].
  3. Click the Inactive tab and search [Part-A].
  4. Open the [Part-A] row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The import finishes without errors.
  • Step 2: [Part-A] is not on the Active tab.
  • Step 3: [Part-A] is listed once (one row, no second copy).
  • Step 4: Sell Price reads $25.00 and the title row pill reads "Inactive".
